documentation.registry-registry-components-layouts:
# Layouts

Reusable compositions that arrange other components.
documentation.registry-registry-components-plugins:
# Plugins

Each plugin owns its UI, types, labels and supporting logic. Optional persistence and service companions stay in its server/ directory. Plugin-specific helpers remain with the plugin; shared consumer-facing helpers belong in utils/. Each plugin has its own AGENTS.md.
documentation.registry-registry-components-connectors:
# Connectors

Each named directory owns one optional integration and its server companion. Agents business connectors reuse plugin services. Host sessions, OAuth wiring and customer-specific adapters remain in consuming websites.
documentation.registry-registry-components-utils:
# Utilities

Shared consumer-facing nonvisual helpers, hooks, data, providers and styles. Helpers used only by one plugin stay with that plugin.
documentation.registry-registry-registry-json:
# Registry manifest

Owns shipped files, installation targets and dependencies. Generated public/r output comes from this manifest.
documentation.registry-registry:
# Distributable source

Portable source and the shadcn manifest. Registry files cannot import showroom code or depend on its framework; tests/registry-distribution.mjs checks those imports and declared dependencies.
documentation.registry-src-routes:
# File routes

TanStack route entry points and page composition. Preserve framework names such as __root.tsx, $locale.agents.tsx and pathless _plugins routes; do not apply ordinary kebab-case renames here.
documentation.registry-src-showroom:
# Preview adapters

Showroom-only mocks, preview controls, framework adapters and demo integrations. Temporary MCP settings belong here and are never distributed to customer sites.
documentation.registry-src-lib:
# Showroom support

Application-owned helpers, locale dictionaries and providers. These files are not registry items.
documentation.registry-src-styles:
# Showroom styles

Application theme and global styles. Reusable component styles remain in their registry-owned location.
documentation.registry-src-routetree-gen-ts:
# Generated routes

TanStack-generated route tree, committed after route changes. Never hand-edit or rename it.
documentation.registry-structures-config-json:
# Saved template

Maintained folder policy for Structures audits. Website exports, if requested, are derived copies.
documentation.registry-structures:
# Structures configuration

The saved local folder and naming policy. Skill scripts stay in the installed Structures skill.
documentation.registry-public-r:
# Generated registry items

Official shadcn build output. Regenerate with pnpm registry:sync; do not edit individual item JSON by hand.
documentation.registry-public:
# Public files

Static showroom assets and generated registry distribution.
documentation.registry-docs:
# Integration and maintenance guides

Registry usage, host wiring, testing and contribution workflows. Observable requirements remain in OpenSpec.
documentation.registry-concepts:
# Registry decisions

Registry-specific architecture decisions; shared Forge decisions remain in forge-specs.
documentation.registry-openspec:
# Registry specifications

Registry-owned behavior and change proposals. Shared host contracts and template requirements belong to forge-specs.
documentation.registry-root:
# Forge Registry

Portable source in registry/, showroom integration in src/, generated artifacts in public/r/, and verification in tests/. The tree is curated; omitted paths are allowed. It neither scaffolds files nor introduces core/shared directories.

## Template source

Derived from the local forge-registry repository root (.), revision fa649440cffda1fccfaa4eead491f4bda4a76192. No previous template was present. Sources: AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md#file-placement, docs/showroom.md#boundaries, docs/agent-workflow.md, registry/registry.json, tsconfig.json and tests/registry-distribution.mjs.

## Validation boundaries

Structures checks the executable naming and placement rules below. Existing registry distribution tests check source ownership, framework independence, imports, manifests and generated output. Public library consumers live in other repositories, so this profile does not infer ownership moves from local usage alone. Preserve framework routes, generated output and installed skill contents. Git history and build caches are not source.

```structures-rules
{
  "ignore": [
    "public/r/**",
    "src/routeTree.gen.ts",
    ".agents/skills/**",
    "node_modules/**",
    ".git/**",
    ".output/**",
    ".tanstack/**",
    "dist/**",
    ".next/**"
  ],
  "required": [
    "registry/registry.json",
    "registry/components",
    "src/routes",
    "src/showroom",
    "tests"
  ]
}
```
